desc: The Valkyrie Deluxe, a deep engraved AR that combines exquisite craftsmanship with unrivaled style. With its distressed purple Cerakote finish on the upper, lower and handguard, this firearm is a true standout in any arsenal. Both sides of the receivers boast deep-engraved, Valkyrie themed artwork, showcasing the fierce and mythical Norse warrior spirit. The Deluxe model goes a step further with the inclusion of a vertical foregrip and flip-up sights, providing enhanced control and accuracy.
